comparison.objective: Support and release a 2 kg monitor from a quick-release stand, then place it upright while held; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Load securing, latch release, bimanual lifting, and placement versus precision hex-key use, collar tuning, relocking, and iterative impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Monitor safely detached and upright on the mat without premature release versus two controlled stops and post-lock drift resistance.
comparison.reason: A latch-and-support removal task does not test adjustable damping. Specs are empty; latch force, final-pose tolerance, and drop/damage thresholds are incomplete.
